intro.ejes: Even without a learning, you can get muscular tension because of these axes of tension. An axis is activated when there is a learning at both of its ends.
intro.planos: They are realities inside us; you can be cut off or blocked. They help us see which of the Universal Laws we are failing in.

1-6.texto: It is neither Yin nor Yang. If I get attached to matter, I get tense at the spiritual level; if I get attached to spirituality, I get tense in matter. We are in matter in order to learn: there is no sense in denying matter, just as there is no sense in denying spirituality. This creates a lot of tension in the cervical vertebrae and in the sexual organs, since this axis cannot be worked on in the body. It is creation, the joy of living, reconnection with myself and with God. Balance is needed; it is not about being left with nothing: it is excessive empathy towards others. Not feeling any need to look after our body — it is necessary. Learning a right spiritual focus in matter; they tend to separate themselves from God and get trapped in the ego.

2-7.texto: There may or may not be tension with a task or a shield. It will be very hard to recognise that we have to be very active. Not changing anyone: understanding, acceptance, being active. Before changing myself, accepting myself with love and understanding. Rigidity is produced on this axis and the person gets emotionally tense about anything to do with the active side. Not making excuses by blaming others. When I do not know how to handle this energy well, I find it hard to see my imperfect side. We have to let ourselves be taught, to teach through others; it prepares us to be active, to take on a Yang part, to form our grounds and find our place. We have to make peace with our masculine part so that we can defend ourselves: I am my father. Not needing anyone to protect me, but being able to protect myself. A need to make something material, problems with making things material. A possibly castrating father, conditional love: if I have no love, I do not find my place.

3-8.texto: Important to handle Yin energy. Yes to life, saying yes actively. Finding what is beautiful in life in order to feel inner harmony and peace of heart. Believing that this is how it is and letting it happen. Feeling what it is I want and being active from inside: unification with myself. Knowing how to settle fights and conflicts, and keeping this from bringing tension to the face, the coccyx and the lower lumbar vertebrae. Not being afraid to be active so as to live and let happen, so that life can give us positive things. We have to have a mother's care towards ourselves: to nourish ourselves, to love ourselves. A father protects us, a mother nourishes us, feeds us, gives us life. The axis of «yes to life», of taking decisions knowing first where I am heading. There is the castrating mother, overprotection; a tendency to be anchored in my fears and not give all of myself that I can give.
3-8.tension: The face, the coccyx and the lower lumbar vertebrae.

4-9.texto: Letting it happen: we cannot do anything to balance the scales of the learning; only acceptance and letting it happen would help us. It gets tense when there is a hard learning. On this axis, rage, anger, feeling that what is happening to us is not fair will only make this axis more tense. This tension has to be let go from deep expression, with love towards myself and understanding of what is happening: it is for my evolution. Karma is balance; we have to work on the things not got past before. I have to have empathy for those people with whom I have karmic matters to settle, especially if I have a path 20 (Judgement). Knowing how to listen, to empathise, to put myself in the other person's place. Carries unresolved matters from other lives: accepting and taking responsibility. Attracts people who act as a mirror for them.
4-9.tension: The mouth, the throat and the thoracic vertebrae.

5-10.texto: Important to go on transforming ourselves, to go on evolving, to close cycles and be able to start new processes: the learnings will bring us the next chance to go on growing. Always being in movement. Transformation is movement: living experiences without fear, being authentic, so as to be able to feel when something is really finished. This axis gets tense when I do not want to be conscious of the things I have to close in order to start new ones. I have to be active on this axis in order to express what I know. Stepping out of social and family ideas that cause clichés, since I will not be able to finish the things I start if they do not come from my unique being. The cycle of learning has to be closed; if it is not, it will bring on an inability to transform and to learn. My soul will take me again and again into a new situation that may be the same as the last one. If it is activated: spiritual neglect, I do not trust my gifts, materialism.
5-10.tension: The belly and the abdominal muscles through to the back, crossing the body like an arrow.

1-6.texto: Ideas come from God. You have to trust that I can be creative. This plane should not be cut off.

2-10.texto: I think I do not deserve it; the ego can be negative or positive. No deserving, justification. The ego of justification: «I cannot do it because…». That means we do not get things in matter. It is blocked if there is a learning at either of those doors. Be careful with the ego of justification. A capacity to notice the deep causes of what happens to me, greater difficulty in seeing them. Everything they wish for comes true; the key is feeling deserving or not.

3-9.texto: Thinking what I want and taking decisions; if I do not take them, the plane gets blocked. I do not stop thinking about the same thing, but I do not take the step. It is an ego of denial. «What is it that I want?»: I take decisions, whatever happens. A logical view, mental control of every aspect of their life. Vulnerability. Activate your inner wisdom, share your truth.

4-8.texto: Emotions are ego too. When emotions flood us, the plane gets blocked. Emotions have to be released, they have to come out, they have to be unblocked. We have to master the emotions, always to feel them. A capacity to develop a proper emotional intelligence, to express what I feel. A disharmonious defence of my inner wishes and needs, constant fights.

5-7.texto: Will, getting yourself going. Held-back action. It gets blocked when I think that «this is not for me». To initiate: God sends me an idea and on this plane I have to put it into practice. It governs my levels of coherence. Do I really do what I feel, knowing that what I feel obeys my soul's will? Difficulty in reconciling feeling and thinking. Coherence between what I am and what I do.
